key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:296CC
name: store_clamped_position_state
description: Limits a signed value to a lower bound when it is negative and to an upper bound when it is not, using two limits stored in the structure. It then writes two input words and the clamped value into fixed structure fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:296DE
name: store_floored_state_words
description: Raises one value to at least a second input value, then writes two input words and the raised value into fixed fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:296E8
name: store_three_state_words
description: Writes three input words into consecutive fixed fields of the structure. No computation is done on them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:296F0
name: accumulate_scaled_matrix_rows
description: Multiplies a three-by-three block of values in the structure by per-row scale factors and a normalized input, then adds the three row sums to accumulator fields. The sums are shifted right by the normalization count; when that count is negative they are added unshifted to low words with carry into the high words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:297C2
name: accumulate_clamped_matrix_rows
description: Computes the same scaled three-by-three product as the unclamped row accumulator, then clamps each row to limit words stored in the structure before adding it to the accumulators. A large-shift branch adds to the low words with carry and stops early if an addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2989C
name: accumulate_bounded_position_totals
description: Adds two input low words into 16-bit fields and applies floor or ceiling limits to the high words of its inputs. It then accumulates three 32-bit totals, writing them only when the additions do not overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:298B6
name: store_fixed_and_accumulate_totals
description: Stores one fixed 32-bit value into an accumulator, raises one input to a floor before adding it to a second accumulator, and clamps a high word for a third. Nothing is written when an addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:298D0
name: store_clamped_sum_record
description: Takes the larger of two input values as a floor, adds a third value to it, and stores that sum with two other inputs into fixed fields of the structure. The store is skipped when the addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:298E2
name: accumulate_shifted_clamped_totals
description: Shifts three inputs right by a count, clamps each against a limit stored in the structure, and adds them to three accumulator fields. Nothing is added if any addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:298F8
name: accumulate_bounded_three_totals
description: Applies a floor or ceiling clamp to each of three inputs using bounds passed in as values, then adds the clamped results to three accumulator fields. Nothing is added if an addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29904
name: accumulate_direct_and_clamped_totals
description: Adds one input unclamped to the first accumulator field, clamps two other inputs to bounds passed in, and adds those to the second and third fields. Nothing is added if any addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29910
name: accumulate_signed_and_clamped_totals
description: Adds one signed input directly to the first accumulator field, clamps a second input to a bound passed in, and clamps a third input against a second bound. The three results are accumulated only when no addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2991C
name: accumulate_two_direct_one_clamped
description: Adds two inputs directly into the first two accumulator fields, clamps a third input against a limit, and adds it to the third accumulator. The update is skipped when any addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29928
name: accumulate_two_direct_one_floored
description: Adds two inputs directly into two accumulator fields and raises a third input to at least a limit before adding it to the third field. Nothing is written when an addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29934
name: accumulate_three_direct_totals
description: Adds three inputs into three accumulator fields without any clamping. The update is skipped entirely if any addition overflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29950
name: scale_normalized_vector_accumulate
description: Returns zero when a status byte is clear. Otherwise it normalizes six 32-bit fields by shifting, derives a scale factor from a division with an unnamed routine's result, and adds the scaled components into 16-bit fields and 32-bit accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:299B6
name: scale_shifted_inputs_into_accumulators
description: Shifts three inputs right by a normalization count and stores them in scratch fields, then computes a scale from an unnamed routine's result and a division. The scaled values are added to 16-bit and 32-bit accumulator fields, and the update is skipped when a status word is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29A62
name: scale_and_accumulate_three_values
description: Multiplies three inputs by a scale value computed from another input, then shifts the products by a count. Non-negative counts add the products to 16-bit fields with carry into the 32-bit accumulators, while negative counts add them straight into the 32-bit accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29ABE
name: shift_and_accumulate_three_totals
description: Shifts three inputs right by a count offset by sixteen when that count is non-negative, then adds them to three 32-bit accumulator fields. Negative counts add the inputs unshifted.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29ADE
name: add_wide_vectors_and_accumulate
description: Copies a status byte from the source structure, then adds three 64-bit values from the source into the destination with carry propagation. It adds the halves of an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and a summed component into three accumulator fields, then calls a second unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29B20
name: subtract_wide_vectors_and_accumulate
description: Copies a status byte from its input, then subtracts three 64-bit values of the second structure from the first with borrow propagation. It subtracts the halves of an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and a difference term from three accumulator fields, then calls further unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29B70
name: select_lowest_cost_candidate
description: Scans a table of flag bytes from high index to low, scoring each flagged entry by a field of the structure scaled by one of two factors chosen from a status byte. It keeps the lowest score, and when the chosen status differs from the current one it updates that status and adjusts the accumulators by the vector difference.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29B78
name: search_flagged_status_candidates
description: Returns early when a lock byte is set. Otherwise it starts from the current status, compares scored candidates from a flag table, and writes the best status into its structure. A changed status triggers a vector copy or a vector difference update of the accumulator fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C02
name: select_status_candidate_by_match
description: Scans a flag table for entries whose status byte matches a target, scores them by a structure field, and keeps the best one under a threshold. It then either copies that candidate's vector into the structure or writes the chosen status and subtracts a vector difference from the accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C34
name: add_wide_vectors_and_accumulate
description: Copies a status byte from the source structure, then adds three 64-bit values from the source into the destination with carry propagation. It adds the halves of an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and a summed component into three accumulator fields, then calls a second unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C3A
name: prepare_and_add_wide_vectors
description: Calls an unnamed routine first, then copies a status byte and adds three 64-bit values from the source into the destination with carry. It adds the halves of another unnamed routine's result and a summed component into three accumulator fields, then calls a further unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C48
name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears one bit in a status byte of the global state. When that bit was previously clear, it scans a table backward from its last entry and, for each entry with a particular bit set, calls an unnamed routine and resets a byte and a 32-bit field of the current object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C7A
name: pass_selected_words_to_routine
description: Chooses one of two sets of four words in the structure depending on a flag byte. When the flag is set it calls an unnamed routine first to update the second set, then passes the four chosen words to another unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29C92
name: copy_state_words_into_buffer
description: Calls an unnamed routine, copies nine words from the structure into a destination buffer, then writes zero into two 32-bit fields and fixed values into two further fields. It calls another unnamed routine afterward.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29CCC
name: transform_cached_vector_by_matrix
description: Decrements a countdown field and resets it when it goes negative, then multiplies a cached three-component vector by a 3x3 matrix from the input and stores the three products. When a flag byte is set, it does the same with a second matrix and writes those products to a second output set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29DB2
name: store_normalized_difference_and_table
description: Subtracts three stored 64-bit values from the current ones with borrow, shifts the differences right until they fit in 16 bits, and stores them as cached shorts. It also copies four 32-bit values from a lookup table selected by a field of the second structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29DBA
name: locate_flagged_entity_store_difference
description: Calls an unnamed routine to advance through objects until one has a particular flag bit set. It then subtracts three stored 64-bit values from the current ones with borrow, shifts the differences into 16-bit range, stores them as cached shorts, and copies four 32-bit values from a lookup table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29E5A
name: store_shorts_and_load_table
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then stores three 16-bit values into fixed fields of the structure. It copies four 32-bit values from a lookup table selected by a three-bit field of the second structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29EFA
name: update_flagged_objects_from_table
description: Sets a flag bit in the global status byte, then scans a table backward for entries with a particular bit set and updates each matching object. Each object's own flag bits decide whether an unnamed routine is called and whether a 16-bit value is loaded from a table, and when an identifier byte matches the global one a 32-bit field is set to a fixed value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:29FE8
name: scan_flagged_objects_continue
description: Continues a backward table scan for entries with a particular bit set and handles each matching object. When an identifier byte matches the global one it sets a 32-bit field to a fixed value, otherwise it calls an unnamed routine, and it applies per-object flag bits with optional unnamed calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A00E
name: reset_flagged_objects_during_scan
description: Scans a table backward for entries with a particular bit set and resets a 32-bit field of each matched object to a fixed value. It applies per-object flag bits, and when an identifier byte differs from the global one it calls an unnamed routine and continues the scan.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: scan_flagged_entries_with_counter
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get a value, then scans a table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each one it calls an unnamed routine, then either stores the value into the object's 16-bit field and calls another unnamed routine, or decrements a countdown byte when that byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A046
name: rescan_flagged_entries_with_counter
description: Stores a word into an object field and calls an unnamed routine, then scans a table backward for entries with a particular bit set. When a countdown byte is zero it stores the word again and restarts the scan; otherwise it decrements the countdown and continues.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A062
name: apply_table_transform_to_accumulators
description: Reads a pair of values from a table indexed by the object's current index, negating matrix rows when certain flag bits are set. It multiplies the rows by the pair, shifts the products right by twelve, and adds them with carry into the object's three 64-bit accumulators. It then sets the table index to a fixed value and calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A09A
name: accumulate_selected_transform_rows
description: Clears a flag bit on the object and multiplies matrix rows by a pair of table values chosen by flag bits. The products are shifted right by twelve and added with carry into the object's three 64-bit accumulators, then the table index is set to a fixed value and an unnamed routine is called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A14C
name: accumulate_transform_rows_directly
description: Clears a flag bit on the object, selects a pair of table values by a sign test, and multiplies three matrix rows by them. The products are shifted right by twelve and added with carry into the object's 64-bit accumulators, then the table index is set to a fixed value and an unnamed routine is called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A1C4
name: clear_object_state_byte
description: Writes zero into one byte of the object's state block, leaving everything else unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CA
name: reset_and_scan_nonzero_entries
description: Resets a countdown word to zero, then scans a byte table backward. For each nonzero entry without a particular bit set, it calls two unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D2
name: call_handler_for_unflagged_entries
description: Scans a byte table backward and skips zero entries. For each nonzero entry without a particular bit set, it calls an unnamed routine and then calls the handler whose address is held in a register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A1F6
name: check_bounds_and_call_handler
description: Scans a byte table backward, skipping entries without a particular bit set. For each entry it calls an unnamed routine and calls the handler in a register only when two signed position fields of the object lie inside a fixed rectangle.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A236
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Stores a table pointer in a global field, then scans a byte table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each entry it calls an unnamed routine, then either reloads a countdown byte and calls a handler from a table indexed by a type byte, or decrements the countdown when it is not yet zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A286
name: dispatch_flagged_entries_by_type
description: Stores a table pointer in a global field, clears one bit of a global status byte, and scans a byte table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each entry it calls an unnamed routine, then calls a handler from a table indexed by the entry's type byte when that byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A2C8
name: write_byte_to_indexed_slot
description: Writes the register byte into a location computed from a stored base pointer plus an index byte held in the object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A2DC
name: store_object_record_in_slot
description: Finds the last entry in a byte table with a particular bit set and, when its index is nonzero, stores a status byte there and decrements a counter word. It then copies a fixed-size record from the input into the slot for that index, and when an extra argument is nonzero it fills several fields from a lookup entry using shifted values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A2FC
name: store_object_record_above_threshold
description: Finds the last entry in a byte table with a particular bit set and, only when its index is above a small fixed threshold, stores a status byte there and decrements a counter word. It then copies a fixed-size record from the input into that slot, filling several fields from a lookup entry when an extra argument is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A324
name: store_object_record_at_index
description: When an index value is nonzero, stores a status byte at that index in a byte table and decrements a counter word. It copies a fixed-size record from the input into the slot for that index, and when an extra argument is nonzero it fills several fields from a lookup entry using shifted values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A330
name: copy_record_and_init_fields
description: Copies a fixed-size record from the source to the destination unless both pointers are the same. When an index value is nonzero, it stores two 32-bit values and the index in the destination, computes shifted values from a lookup entry into its fields, clears several flag bytes, and fills 16-bit fields from the same entry when an offset is present.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A4F2
name: store_record_in_free_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for a free entry above a fixed threshold, falling back to an entry with a particular bit set when none is free. It stores a status byte in the chosen entry, adjusts a counter word, copies the fixed-size input record into that slot, and fills lookup-derived fields when an extra argument is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A512
name: store_record_in_empty_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for a free entry above zero, falling back to an entry with a particular bit set when none is free. It stores a status byte in the chosen entry, adjusts a counter word, copies the fixed-size input record into that slot, and fills lookup-derived fields when an extra argument is nonzero.

name: clear_buffer_from_pointer
description: Stores a buffer pointer in a global field, then zeroes one byte at a time across a fixed block of about 115 bytes starting at that pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A674
name: clear_flagged_table_entries
description: Resets a counter word to zero, then clears every entry of a byte table that has a particular bit set. The scan runs backward over the whole table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A696
name: clear_entry_and_decrement
description: Clears the table entry whose index is stored in the input object. When that entry had a particular bit set, it also decrements a counter word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A6BA
name: call_unnamed_routine_only
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A6C4
name: notify_slots_and_clear_entry
description: Clears the table entry named by the input object. When that entry did not have a particular bit set, it first calls a handler on each active slot in a list of fixed-stride records; otherwise it decrements a counter word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A710
name: update_countdown_and_expire
description: Calls handlers for active slots, then either returns early through an unnamed routine when a flag or lookup value says so, or subtracts an amount from a countdown word. When the countdown runs out it updates a second counter and, depending on checks, calls unnamed routines and resets several object fields to fixed values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A7CE
name: call_handler_and_return_one
description: Calls the handler stored at a fixed slot of a global table, then returns a value combining one with a register input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A7E6
name: call_handler_and_mark_flag
description: Calls a handler from a global table, sets one bit of a status byte in the object, and calls a second handler when a state byte equals a fixed value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A800
name: process_object_state
description: When a channel byte matches a global value, adds a lookup amount to a running total and invokes a callback on overflow. It then calls handlers, resets several object fields to fixed values, adjusts an object counter from a lookup entry, and calls a handler a number of times based on its result when an index is in a fixed range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A99A
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without changing any other state.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A0
name: initialize_object_and_accumulate
description: Stores a value in a 16-bit field and sets several object fields to fixed values. It calls handlers to obtain two values, adds them shifted right into three 32-bit accumulator fields, then returns the result of another unnamed call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AA0A
name: classify_value_into_bands
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then either finds a threshold band for a limit-checked value and adjusts two counters, or reads a value and classifies it into one of several bands. Matching bands clear per-object fields or add table-driven amounts to 16-bit totals, and handlers are called depending on the object's state byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AA5A
name: extract_flag_from_mask
description: Repeatedly picks a bit index through a handler until it finds a bit that is set in the object's first mask, then moves that bit from the first mask into the second mask.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AAAC
name: apply_value_band_update
description: Classifies the input value into one of three bands. The two lower bands read a per-object index byte and add a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals when the object's state byte is set, while the top band clears an entry in a per-object table. It then calls handlers depending on the state byte and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AAE6
name: consume_object_band_index
description: Reads and clears an index byte from the object and clears a 32-bit field. When the object's state byte is set, it adds a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals and calls handlers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AB1A
name: mark_object_band_index
description: When an object's index byte is nonzero, sets that byte to one and, if the state byte is set, adds a table-driven amount minus a small fixed offset to three 16-bit totals. It then calls handlers depending on the state byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AB50
name: count_threshold_band_hit
description: Compares an input value against a 16-bit total and, when it is below that total, searches a threshold table for its band. The matched band's count is decremented and a separate counter is incremented, and a handler is called when the object's state byte is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AB84
name: update_speed_and_budget
description: Moves a speed word toward its target by a fraction of the input step and decays two timer bytes and a countdown word. It then computes a cost from the absolute values of three state words, subtracts it from a budget word, and when the budget runs out it consumes a counter or triggers a handler before clearing three 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AC6E
name: consume_budget_and_reset_fields
description: Subtracts an input amount from a budget word and returns early while budget remains. When the budget is exhausted it consumes a counter or triggers a handler depending on a global channel byte, then clears three 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2ACA8
name: consume_reserve_counter
description: If a reserve counter is nonzero, it decrements that counter, increments a second counter, and refills the budget word. Otherwise it sets bit 0 of a global status byte, calls a handler if that bit was previously clear, and clears three 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB8
name: tick_countdown_refill_budget
description: If a countdown byte is nonzero, decrements it and adds a fixed amount to the budget word. Otherwise it clears three 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2ACD0
name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: Sets bit 0 of a global status byte and calls a handler when that bit was previously clear. It then clears three 32-bit fields of the object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AD02
name: tick_global_timer_and_apply
description: Subtracts an amount from a global 32-bit timer and returns while time remains. When the timer runs out it refills it, decrements two counters, and compares lookup results against them. When the comparisons allow and the object has a pending index byte, it clears that byte, adds a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0A
name: refill_global_timer_and_apply
description: Refills a global 32-bit timer, decrements two counters, and compares lookup results against them. When the comparisons allow and the object has a pending index byte, it clears that byte, adds a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AD42
name: consume_pending_band_index
description: When an object's index byte is nonzero, clears it and clears a 32-bit field. It adds a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals and then calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AD76
name: consume_band_index_when_due
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns unless its low byte exceeds a counter word. When the object's index byte is nonzero, it clears that byte and a 32-bit field, adds a table-driven amount to three 16-bit totals, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2AD7C
name: consume_band_index_then_handler
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when a flag condition holds and a counter gate passes, applies a table-driven band update to three 16-bit totals for a pending index byte. It calls a handler afterwards unless the gate returns early.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_state_word_notify
description: Stores an input word in a state field of the global block. When the previous value was nonzero, it also calls a handler from the table entry selected by that old value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_state_word
description: Stores an input word into a state field of the global block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_scaled_table_value
description: Maps an input value to an entry of a global lookup table using one of several index formulas chosen by the value's magnitude. It returns the entry shifted right by an amount that depends on the same range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_entity_table
description: Writes a state word to zero and two fixed seed values into the global block, then fills a table of slot pointers. It loops over each slot, copies the first word of its record into a field, and calls the handler stored in the record's second word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: initialize_and_iterate_table
description: When an input value is below a threshold, sets two seed values. It then clears a state word, initializes several global fields, and runs five passes over the slot table, calling each slot's handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: run_periodic_slot_updates
description: Clears three status bits and calls a handler on each slot whose marker byte is nonzero. When a global 32-bit counter has advanced past a fixed period, it runs whole periods, calls a periodic handler on flagged slots with the period count, and scans a byte table backward for entries with a particular bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_slot_handlers_if_active
description: Walks a list of fixed-stride slot records and calls the handler stored in each record for slots whose active byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: dispatch_slot_matching_code
description: Tests a bit of a global status byte and, when the test passes, obtains a code from a handler and searches a slot table for a matching code byte. A matching slot's handler is called after a dispatch step, and a fallback handler is called when no slot matches; the branch depends on flags left by the handler call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_handler_by_bit_mask
description: Maps an input code to one of several bit positions by comparing it against four fixed values, defaulting to a fixed bit otherwise. It then calls the handler at a fixed offset in each slot whose marker byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Advances two 32-bit state words with a shift, rotate and XOR mix, storing the new pair back into the global block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: compute_scaled_random_value
description: Advances two 32-bit state words with a rotate and addition, then multiplies the input's low word by the new high word and returns that product in the result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_state
description: Computes a derived 16-bit factor from two register inputs, multiplies the input's low word by it, and returns the scaled product.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement negation, propagating the borrow between the high and low halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: multiply_wide_difference_fixed
description: Subtracts two 64-bit values, and when the difference is non-negative multiplies its parts by a 32-bit factor to form a scaled 64-bit product. A negative difference instead takes an unnamed routine's 64-bit result and negates it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: perform_32x32_multiplication
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products, adds a third term when a register is nonzero, and returns the 64-bit result with normalized bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: compute_scaled_offset_vectors
description: Takes differences of two pairs of values returned by unnamed routines and stores them in the object. It then multiplies three components by a fraction derived from a register and stores the shifted products into six 32-bit fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_longs_and_shifted_copies
description: Stores three 32-bit inputs in the first three long fields, then stores three copies of other inputs shifted left by one less than a count into the next three long fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three short values from the object by a factor derived from an input and a stored field, shifting the products into place in a loop. It adds the results into the object's three 64-bit accumulators with carry propagation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts how many right shifts reduce an input to zero, calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value, and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: rescale_result_by_normalization
description: Shifts an input right until it fits in 15 bits, counting the shifts, then calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the two's complement negation of the 64-bit value it produces.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: scale_fixed_point_by_input
description: Chooses one of three paths by the sign and high word of an input. A negative value negates an unnamed routine's 64-bit result, a zero high word multiplies two 32-bit parts by a scaled input and shifts the product, and any other value counts shifts to normalize the input and shifts the unnamed routine's result left by that count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: scale_fixed_point_by_flag
description: Chooses between a scaled 64-bit multiply and a normalization path based on a processor flag set by the caller. The scaled path multiplies two 32-bit parts by a shifted input, while the other path counts shifts and shifts an unnamed routine's 64-bit result left by that count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_fixed_point_pair
description: Shifts an input right by seven and, when the result is below a fixed limit, multiplies two 32-bit parts by it and returns the shifted product. Otherwise it shifts the value right until it fits, calls an unnamed routine, and shifts that 64-bit result left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_and_round
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by a 16-bit multiplier using 16-bit partial products, then shifts each product right by one bit and returns both as a 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: add_wide_result_to_accumulators
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a 64-bit value and adds its halves and two register values into three 64-bit accumulator pairs, propagating carries between the 32-bit lanes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. It does no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. It does no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. It does no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns a 16-bit word read from the global base pointer plus an offset passed in a register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_two_longs_global
description: Stores two 32-bit inputs in consecutive global fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: reset_global_base_pointers
description: Sets two global 32-bit fields to the address of the shared data block, restoring their default values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: allocate_indexed_slot_offset
description: When a byte in a table at the given index is zero and a running offset word is below a fixed limit, stores the offset's low byte there, records the index with the offset in a word slot, and advances the offset by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: allocate_offset_entry_record
description: When a running offset word is below a fixed limit, writes its low byte into a buffer at an index, records the index and offset in a word slot, and advances the offset by four. Otherwise it writes nothing and returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_index
description: Writes a byte into a buffer at an offset, stores the offset and byte together as a 32-bit record at an index-derived location, and advances a stored pointer by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: stub_return_only
description: This is a stub that contains only a return and performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: check_screen_bounds_and_call
description: Tests two coordinate pairs against a fixed screen rectangle of about 320 by 168 pixels, obtaining clipped values from an unnamed routine when a pair is out of range. It returns early if the adjusted values are still outside the rectangle, and otherwise calls an unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: call_unnamed_routine_only
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_screen_rect_and_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns if its result lies outside a fixed screen rectangle. Otherwise it checks a second pair of values against the same rectangle and calls another unnamed routine when both are inside.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: call_if_on_screen
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a coordinate pair and calls another unnamed routine only when that pair lies inside a fixed screen rectangle.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: trigger_state_on_flag_bits
description: Checks flag bits in the object's flag word. When bit 128 or bit 8 is set, it sets a global status bit, sets a state byte to two, updates two object status bits and calls a handler; the 128 case also sets a second global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets two global status bits, sets a state byte of the object to two, updates a status bit in the object, clears another, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets one global status bit, sets a state byte of the object to two, updates two object status bits, and calls a handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: handle_flag_bit_event
description: When bit 1024 of the object's flag word is set, clears it and adds four to a counter, either the global one or the object's own depending on a state byte. It then sets a timer byte to seven, updates two status bits, calls two handlers and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: store_flags_and_add_counter
description: Stores an input value as the object's flag word and adds four to a counter, either the global one or the object's own depending on a state byte. It then sets a timer byte to seven, updates two status bits, calls two handlers and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: set_object_state_and_flags
description: Adds four to the object's counter field, sets a timer byte to seven, updates two status bits, calls two handlers, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: call_handler_below_limit
description: When an object's index word is below a fixed limit and the two object pointers differ, calls an unnamed routine, then calls a handler if the value it returned is below a fixed threshold.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: apply_costed_table_action
description: Returns early unless a per-channel table entry is nonzero, a lock word is zero, an accumulator is below a fixed cap, and a 32-bit field is nonzero. It then calls handlers and either adds a table-keyed cost to a 16-bit accumulator with saturation or copies six 32-bit values into the object and sets several object fields to fixed values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
name: accumulate_table_cost_with_lock
description: Reads a value from a table keyed by a type code in the object's flags.
